AND(
OR(ISCHANGED(FundingTier__c),NOT(ISBLANK(FundingTier__c))),
OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(NOARecevied__c, "Yes")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Review")) ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IVF_Application', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IVF_Application_Read_Only' ) )
